_tool_description: Queue a coding task for execution by the most cost-effective LLM available and return immediately with a task_id. Prefers local models (LM Studio / Ollama) when they are capable enough, falling back to free or paid API models only when needed. The caller should poll get_task_status with the returned task_id to track progress and retrieve the final result. When live job monitoring is available, the response also includes a monitoring.websocketUrl link plus MCP job resource URIs for active jobs and per-job progress. Use this tool when you want the task actually executed asynchronously, not just planned.
